digest.component_or_area: test harness and conftest isolation guards
propositions: Detached pytest runs report failures that do not reproduce in foreground, making external-actor concurrent mutations indistinguishable from real test defects
The _no_repo_root_leaks autouse fixture misattributes external top-level file creation to an innocent test and silently deletes the external file
Browser e2e tests fail with empty stderr on signal-killed children (returncode -9/-15) but the diagnostic does not inspect returncode, conflating crashes with product failures
Detached runs enable concurrent checkout mutation by the launching agent, which a foreground run prevents structurally by blocking; detachment is enabler not cause
The _no_repo_root_leaks and _no_repo_commits guards both attribute external mutations to tests with false or destructive prescriptions rather than naming the concurrent-actor cause
